fact: NIMC's Alvan Ikoku says the identity database is hosted in Nigeria and managed by NIMC employees, not vendors.
Ikoku says NIMC maintains its core database internally with its own staff.
NIMC director-general said the commission's own Self-Service Modification Platform had processed close to two million record updates, cutting turnaround from weeks to 24-48 hours.
TechCabal reports that NIMC implements the ID4D project and is enrolling 1.5 to 1.8 million people a month and issuing NINs.
